results.content: Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Tesla announced plans to build Terafab, a $16.8 billion semiconductor manufacturing facility in Grimes County, Texas, north of Houston, with the potential to eventually reach $119 billion in total investment across multiple phases. The complex will span 100 million square feet and create more than 3,000 jobs, according to announcements made August 6-7, 2026.
results.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX, Tesla to build $16.8B Terafab chip factory in Texas
